name: KNIGHT
_about: Overrides the vanilla Knight with only a mon_sprite_swap: every vanilla goblin body becomes spr_sp_drip_1, a stand-in the scenario can recognise. The sprites cells draw themselves (DRINK goblin, second G.BANG goblin) and the carrying ogre's walk become spr_title_top, which no cell ever draws.

name: GIANT
_about: Overrides the vanilla Giant with only a mon_sprite_swap of the monster heads the GIANT cell draws itself.

name: BARE CLASS
_about: A new class with no clothing maps at all: it must wear the Peasant's instead of crashing in vanilla cells.
